# SourceToken

- Namespace: `PPDS.Dataverse.Sql.Intellisense`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`
- Kind: Struct
- Implements: `IEquatable<SourceToken>`

## Summary

A token with position and classification for syntax highlighting.
Language-agnostic — the `PPDS.Dataverse.Sql.Intellisense.SourceTokenType` determines rendering color.

#### SourceToken(int Start, int Length, SourceTokenType Type)

`SourceToken(int Start, int Length, SourceTokenType Type)`

A token with position and classification for syntax highlighting.
Language-agnostic — the `PPDS.Dataverse.Sql.Intellisense.SourceTokenType` determines rendering color.

- Param `Start`: Character offset where the token begins in the source text.

- Param `Length`: Number of characters in the token.

- Param `Type`: The classification of the token for highlighting purposes.
